headline: GOLD SURGES TO $4,578 — Iran Deal Optimism Lifts Metal Toward $4,600 After Two Weekly Losses
snippet: Gold jumped 1.2% to $4,578 Monday as Trump confirmed a memorandum of understanding with Iran is largely negotiated, easing oil-driven inflation fears and softening the U.S. dollar. The metal had retreated toward $4,450 last week on hawkish Fed rate expectations; traders now eye $4,600 as next resistance ahead of Nonfarm Payrolls later this week.

headline: SILVER OUTPACES GOLD: 2.6% Surge Squeezes Gold-Silver Ratio to 58.9 — Lowest in Months
snippet: Silver climbed to $77.50 while gold gained 1.2%, compressing the gold-silver ratio to 58.9 — a historically significant threshold where industrial and investment demand converge simultaneously. The ratio's rapid compression is a direct tailwind for silver-focused junior miners and royalty streams.

headline: GR SILVER DRILLS BEST-EVER HOLE: 45.1m at 1,623 g/t Ag — Includes 8.25m at 8,579 g/t at San Marcial
snippet: GR Silver Mining (TSXV: GRSL) posted its strongest drill result ever at the San Marcial deposit in Sinaloa, Mexico — hole SMS26-04 returned 45.1m true width at 1,623 g/t silver from 268m depth, including an 8.25m core at 8,579 g/t Ag with 1.6% Pb and 5.5% Zn. The company calls it the best intercept from San Marcial to date and confirmation of high-grade continuity.

headline: COLLECTIVE MINING Finds 700-Metre Oxide Zone From Surface: 71m at 1.95 g/t AuEq at Apollo, Colombia
snippet: Collective Mining (TSX: CNL) delineated a new precious metal-rich oxidized zone at Northern Apollo spanning 700m strike by 200m width, beginning at surface — a potentially heap-leachable layer sitting on top of its flagship Apollo copper-gold porphyry system in Caldas, Colombia. The company holds US$113M in cash and is running 100,000m of drilling in 2026.

headline: TROILUS EXPANDS West Rim: 2.92 g/t AuEQ Over 19m Outside Resource, Within 200m of Reserve Pit
snippet: Troilus Mining (TSX: TLG) hit 2.92 g/t AuEQ over 19m at the West Rim Zone — outside the current resource but within 200m of the North Reserve Pit from its 2024 Feasibility Study. Hole WR-26-016 also returned the zone's strongest single intercept to date: 7.82 g/t AuEQ over 5m. Analysts are flagging M&A potential given the near-pit grade-thickness.

headline: AYA GOLD SILVER: 890 g/t AgEq Over 51.5m at Boumadine — New Parallel Structure Opens Pit Depth
snippet: Aya Gold & Silver (TSX: AYA) drilled 890 g/t AgEq over 51.5m at its Boumadine project in Morocco, including 1,504 g/t AgEq over 19.3m. A new parallel mineralized structure intersected 70m below the current resource pit shell could expand both tonnes and depth of the planned open pit ahead of a mid-year preliminary economic assessment.

headline: SIGMA LITHIUM SHARES CRATER 15% — Brazil Court Ruling on Waste Violations Triggers Emergency Appeal
snippet: A local Brazilian judge issued an order against Sigma Lithium (NASDAQ: SGML) related to alleged waste management violations at the Grota do Cirilo operation, wiping 15% from the share price in a single session. The company is appealing, calling the ruling legally unfounded, but the episode exposes how Brazil's regulatory environment can blindside lithium investors without warning.

headline: FRONTIER NUCLEAR Nears Maiden Uranium Resource at Namibia's Engo Valley — Mid-Q3 2026 on Track
snippet: Frontier Nuclear (NASDAQ: FNUC) has received all Phase 2 drill assays from Engo Valley in Namibia — the world's third-largest uranium producer — and is on schedule to publish a maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate by mid-Q3 2026. The timing aligns with accelerating U.S. policy support for domestic nuclear fuel cycle investment.

headline: COCHILCO RAISES 2026 Copper Forecast to $5.55/lb — AI Data Centre Electrification Joins EV as Key Driver
snippet: Chile's state copper commission raised its 2026 average price forecast to $5.55/lb, with 2027 seen at $5.10/lb, citing firm demand from the energy transition, EVs, and AI-linked data centre electrification. Global refined copper demand is expected to rise 1.5% to 28.2M tonnes this year, though a slim 12,000-tonne surplus is forecast after 2025's deficit.

headline: NdPr OXIDE SLIDES 21% IN APRIL to $99.61/kg — But Up 88% YTD as Rare Earth Cycle Consolidates
snippet: NdPr oxide posted its sharpest monthly decline since the Q1 rally, falling 21% in April to $99.61/kg, though it remains 88% above January's open near $53/kg. The market is bifurcating sharply: Western producers MP Materials and Lynas both operate above their cost bases, while Chinese domestic prices diverge significantly from international benchmarks.

headline: COT REPORT May 22: Gold Spec Longs at Multi-Month Lows — Contrarian Setup Building at $4,500
snippet: The May 22 Commitment of Traders report shows gold speculative net longs at their lowest level since February, while silver managed funds remain cautiously positioned despite six straight years of structural supply deficit. That combination historically precedes sharp short-covering rallies once a catalyst — such as today's Iran peace deal developments — arrives.
